document.slice: P1A.3a — receive-only channel and inbox ingestion

priorDeployment.migration117: Applied, reported by user on 2026-11-03. Not independently checked in production.
priorDeployment.applicationDeployment: No new application deployment verified in this task.

implemented: Official Cloud API raw-byte HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification and GET challenge handling, mounted before JSON parsing and request logging.
Deployment-owned per-tenant account/phone profiles with secret references; manager-only Company integration controls enable/pause receiving, optimistic revisions and audit.
Atomic bounded webhook batch insert with durable acknowledgement and unique provider-event keys. No AI or provider network work in webhook requests.
Separate database-only worker with SKIP LOCKED receipts, same-contact advisory locking, rollback-safe processing, bounded exponential retry and failed-message health.
Exact channel/sender identity creates or reuses one lead; no merging by name/phone with manual leads or student accounts. Published language and active enquiry owner/fallback defaults.
Incoming text and Business App echoes appear in the existing inbox. Echoes pause ownership; exact text opt-outs stay opted out. Closed leads remain closed.
Audio/media events display a review placeholder and retain an opaque media ID, MIME type and voice marker for later processing. No downloads, URLs, bytes or transcription.
Status/unsupported-event receipts do not create leads. Processed receipt payloads are reduced to safe reconciliation metadata; message text lives in the authorized timeline.

voiceRequirement.input: Either WhatsApp text or voice message.
voiceRequirement.response: Both text and generated voice replies based on the same grounded answer, in the customer language.
voiceRequirement.delivery: Track text/audio outcomes separately; retry only the failed part and avoid repeating a successfully delivered reply.
voiceRequirement.currentBoundary: Only incoming media references and inbox placeholders are implemented here. Transcription, speech generation and outbound delivery remain future work. Text-only initial pilot must not be described as the finished requirement.

security.scope: Raw callback profile comes from deployment configuration, never browser or payload tenant claims. Account and phone IDs must match. Runtime operations use SET LOCAL ROLE sophia_runtime_app, verified tenant context and FORCE RLS.
security.secrets: App secret and verification token are server environment secret references. No access token is needed for receive-only processing. Browser sees labels/readiness only; no secrets or provider IDs.
security.authority: Company integration API uses the existing active organisation_owner/chief_executive authority. Cross-company forms do not mount the signed-in company connection card.
security.consent: Inbound customer timestamps and sticky opt-out are separate from conversation ownership. Business App echoes never open an inbound customer reply window. No consent or reply-window permission is inferred merely from a stored phone number.
security.sideEffects: No production data access, migration, provider provisioning, live WhatsApp/AI/speech requests, messages or student/invoice/contact changes performed.

schema: 118_whatsapp_inbound_channel.sql after 117; generic tenant-RLS channel bindings, receive receipts and channel contacts. Explicit grants override inherited defaults. Existing settings audit vocabulary gains channel_updated.

configuration.instructions: Example IDs are synthetic; replace with the authorized Runtime customer, actual WABA/phone and deployment secret-variable names. Set those secret values using the deployment secret store. App secret and random verification token must each be at least 16 characters. Every backend/worker instance must share the same profile map. Phone IDs and profile IDs must be unique. Restart worker/backend after changing profiles or secrets.
configuration.WHATSAPP_INBOUND_WORKER_ENABLED: true only on the dedicated authorized receive worker; absent/false stops the worker. This does not itself enable a channel binding.

deployment: Build/package Runtime migrations and apply migration 118 through the existing owner-operated migration runner after 117. No production migration was run here.
Deploy the Business Manager backend/frontend. No live receiving occurs with the default empty profile map. Publish valid assistant Settings before enabling receiving.
Configure a test-number profile and secret references in backend and worker. Use a dedicated test number before onboarding the existing Business App number.
An authorized manager enables receiving in Company → WhatsApp. Run the dedicated worker with WHATSAPP_INBOUND_WORKER_ENABLED=true.

Register the profile callback URL and verification token with the authorized Meta app. Callback routing is profile-specific: deliveries must belong to the configured WABA/phone. Mixed-account/number payloads fail closed; configure number-specific callback routing before sharing an app across profiles. Subscribe to messages and, when supported and verified, smb_message_echoes.

Test signed inbound text, audio placeholder and Business App echoes. Confirm queue drains, repeated delivery creates no duplicate timeline entries, wrong signatures fail, app replies pause ownership and opt-out remains sticky.

Verify existing-number Business App coexistence eligibility and actual echo payloads/subscriptions before production onboarding. No embedded signup, provider provisioning or coexistence eligibility check is implemented in this slice.

Rollback: pause receiving in Company and stop the receive worker. Existing leads remain visible; queued receipts remain durable. Disabled callbacks return 503 so provider retries can resume, subject to provider retention limits. Do not remove queued records or change profile/customer/phone bindings to repurpose an existing profile.

operations.limits: 256 KB raw callback, at most 100 normalized events, one bulk receipt insert, 4,000 retained text characters with truncation marker, bounded 50-event timeline pages. One receipt/channel/tick per worker process; no unbounded fan-out.
operations.fairness: Database-only transaction commits timeline write and processed receipt together. Worker restart resumes queued events. Multiple workers coordinate via SKIP LOCKED and same-sender transaction locks.
operations.attention: Company panel shows queued/failed counts and oldest waiting receipt. Monitor worker tick failures (profile ID only), queue age and failed counts. No live throughput or p95 benchmark was performed.
operations.recovery: Failed receipts stop after eight attempts; inspect safe failure_code, fix configuration/code, then perform a separately authorized bounded retry under the scoped Runtime role. No automatic infinite retry or destructive cleanup. Queued/failed content requires the tenant retention/access policy before live launch.
operations.ordering: Deduplicate by channel/event key. Concurrent receipt append order may differ from provider send order; timeline metadata retains sentAt, while last_inbound_at uses GREATEST so late arrivals do not regress it.
operations.deliveryReceipts: Received statuses are durably classified; outgoing message reconciliation, monotonic delivery state and send ambiguity handling are not implemented yet.
operations.media: Unsupported media is not fetched. Opaque media references are retained for P1B; test real audio formats and provider media retention before enabling automatic transcription.

verification.backend: 45 tests passed in six focused suites: 18 new webhook/real PostgreSQL channel checks plus 27 existing lead/Settings regressions. Includes raw signature/size/tenant spoofing, batch deduplication, concurrent same-contact processing, pause/resume, closed leads, sticky opt-out, app echoes, retry exhaustion, rollback, RLS and default-grant protection.
verification.realEstate: All 38 deterministic tests passed across the eight existing test:p0:real-estate suites.
verification.browser: 43 tests passed at desktop 1902x1016 and mobile 390x844, including Company integration shared controls, loading, cancellation, optimistic saves, errors, no credential fields, and light/dark layout. Three additional Company checks passed, including a new cross-company visibility guard regression.
verification.compile: Application TypeScript passed. Bounded-worker production frontend build passed with existing initial/style-budget, CommonJS and missing primeicons warnings.
verification.architecture: Boundary scan still reports only the two unchanged pre-existing student-document-analysis.worker.ts/spec.ts vendor imports. No new violations.
verification.hygiene: JavaScript syntax, JSON parsing and both repository diff checks passed.
